about: sites a sirven node may carry for other sirven users. only the approved list is eligible; pending and declined are published so operators see what is coming and what was refused. the matching rules and the review rubric are in docs/allowlist-review.md.

matching.domain: lowercase punycode host name, no scheme, port, path, or trailing dot
matching.includes_subdomains: false: the exact host only. true: the host and every subdomain
matching.scope: public_pages: requests without the user's login. authenticated_sessions: requests carrying the user's session
